activity.notes: Banco de la República's historical synthesis identifies Saguamanchica as zipa or great lord of Bacatá and places him around 1470-1490. Because this pre-conquest chronology is reconstructed from later colonial-era traditions rather than contemporary dated records, ATLAS records both boundaries as approximate and uses Bacatá rather than the broad Chibcha cultural-linguistic label.

sources.title: Los señores Muiscas — Banco de la República
sources.citation_text: Banco de la República identifies Saguamanchica as zipa or gran señor de Bacatá and gives the traditional chronology 1470-1490.
